card.title: Ways to Decode a Digit String

a1.cap: Letters are encoded as 1 → A, 2 → B, …, 26 → Z. Return the number of ways to decode the digit string s.
a1.say: Letters are encoded as 1 to A, 2 to B,..., 26 to Z. Return the number of ways to decode the digit string s.

lines: Letters are encoded as 1 → A, 2 → B, …, 26 → Z. Return the number of ways to decode the digit string s.

a1.cap: For example, with s = "12", the answer is 2. AB or L.
a1.say: For example, with s equals "12", the answer is 2. AB or L.

a1.cap: Ways to decode the first i digits = ways for i − 1 (if digit i is 1–9) plus ways for i − 2 (if the last two digits form 10–26). Keep a rolling window of the last two counts.
a1.say: Ways to decode the first i digits equals ways for i minus 1 (if digit i is 1 to 9) plus ways for i minus 2 (if the last two digits form 10 to 26). Keep a rolling window of the last two counts.

a1.cap: Let's walk through it with s = "226".

a1.cap: Time complexity is O(n) and extra space is O(1).
a1.say: Time complexity is O of n and extra space is O of one.
